settings.absolute_tolerance_basis: kg per pivot and kg in discharge/fines states; exact diagonal change from scaled number inventory
settings.title: Cone-mill forward uncertainty: Bhonsale et al. (2018)

source_to_code.pce2: Nine centre/axial points at +/-sqrt(3) SD augmented with 23 LHS points in +/-2 SD. Declared reconstruction of the described 32-point hybrid; original points are unavailable.
source_to_code.pce1: Primary: caption-consistent twelve-point LHS in the +/-2 SD reference box. Prose instead says nine sigma points; a nine-point centre/axial design is a separate sensitivity check. Original points are unavailable.
source_to_code.initial_condition: Reconstruction assumption: initially empty mill. The paper does not specify a complete initial state; d50 at t=0 is undefined.
source_to_code.equations: 18-24: total-number inventory, volume-weighted feed, algebraic screen discharge, breakage selection and daughter conservation; 25-27: fixed-pivot approximation
source_to_code.published_31s: MC Gaussian-fit mean 208.366 micrometres and SD 41.7409 micrometres (12000 draws); these are comparison values, not calibration targets.
source_to_code.fixed_pivot: Positive linear hat functions in volume, Kumar & Ramkrishna (1996), DOI 10.1016/0009-2509(96)88489-2. Printed Eq 27 has inconsistent integration limit/numerator; its literal negative expression is not used.
source_to_code.screen: Fout=(1-fd)*(Fin+B-SN); instantaneous sub-first-pivot daughter volume is discharged as fines, separately accounted.
source_to_code.bands: Primary: pointwise 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Additional mean +/-1.96 SD is an explicitly approximate Gaussian-reference band. The source prose says F distribution, while Eq 7 uses a t critical value; missing degrees of freedom prevent a unique source-band reconstruction. Neither band is an interval for the mean or simultaneous coverage.
source_to_code.joint_law: Four independent Gaussians with Table 1 means/SDs. Independence is assumed because dependence is unspecified. Invalid physical draws are recorded, never clipped or redrawn.
source_to_code.grid: Reconstruction assumption: geometric volume pivots, 100 points, first 6.54e-17 m3 (published), last 1e-3 m3 (declared here). Arithmetic bin centres are those pivots.
source_to_code.daughter_measure: Expected number density on 0<v<=parent; normalized by its first relative-volume moment, not by daughter count.
source_to_code.training_law: Bounded training boxes do not truncate the propagated Gaussian input law. Validation and MC use full Gaussian reference samples.
source_to_code.units: SI: m3 particle volume, m diameter, kg inventory, s time, RPM speed; reported outlet diameter in micrometres
source_to_code.median: Reconstruction assumption: instantaneous outlet VOLUME-weighted diameter median, with linear interpolation between cumulative fixed-pivot volume values in diameter. The 2018 paper does not specify median interpolation or weighting explicitly.
source_to_code.feed: Volume-weighted LogNormal(log(4.81e-5 m3),0.25); exact bin probabilities, converted to count feed by mass_feed/(rho*pivot). Resolved probabilities normalized explicitly; excluded fraction reported.
source_to_code.speed: 4923 RPM for t<30 s; 1500 RPM for t>=30 s. Two separate BDF integrations, no stage crosses the change.
